title: Reflex · modelless: laya's answers distilled into a µs head
intro: Press play to walk the same recorded turn through the distillation: the same sentence in, a different pick out — in microseconds.

walk.title: The same sentence
walk.text: The distillation changes nothing about the input: the very same recorded opening turn the laya lane reads. That is the point — same question, a different (much cheaper) answerer.

in.label: the same recorded opening turn
in.from: recorded from the KatGPT modelless lane, seed 607, 2026-09-25, arena/demo_oracle.json _meta.sources.tetris_head · scripts/record_demo_walks.mjs · the opening turn (turn 0)

walk.title: Decode to features
walk.text: The sentence is decoded back into the board features it came from: holes left, how flat the surface sits, stack height, which side it lands on, lines cleared. A handful of numbers — no words reach the head.

walk.title: A tiny linear head
walk.text: A small linear head, fitted offline on laya's recorded answers, scores the features. It imitates laya — 44 of 120 picks agree on the pinned corpus — so it plays like laya, only about a hundred-thousand times faster.

out.label: the head's answer to the same turn
out.from: recorded from the KatGPT modelless lane, seed 607, 2026-09-25, arena/demo_oracle.json _meta.sources.tetris_head · scripts/record_demo_walks.mjs · the opening turn's answer

walk.title: Play the highest
walk.text: The top-scoring spot drops. The head runs as WebAssembly in your tab — it is the lane playing live in the arena below, one pick per piece at microsecond cost.
